Home.metaTitle: Full Stack FastAPI — a web app template
Home.metaDescription: A production-ready template: FastAPI and PostgreSQL on the backend, Next.js and HeroUI on the frontend, with accounts, email confirmation and an admin area.
Home.heroTitle: FastAPI and Next.js, ready to build on
Home.heroDescription: Accounts with email confirmation, password recovery, an admin area and two languages already work. Start with your own pages instead of the plumbing.
Home.feature_backend_text: FastAPI, SQLModel and asynchronous PostgreSQL, with a layered architecture and a fully tested API.
Home.feature_frontend_text: Next.js renders the public pages on the server in every language, so they load fast and are indexed.
Home.feature_auth_text: The session lives in an httpOnly cookie, emails are confirmed, and passwords are reset by a one-time link.
